verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Deployments as a containers-as-a-service offering for running container images and serving ML models, which addresses the core of deploying code without managing always-on instances. The evidence never mentions autoscaling or scale-to-zero. Machine auto-shutdown is an adjacent VM feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented autoscaling of GPU workers, scale-to-zero behavior, per-request or serverless billing details, hands-on corroboration of Deployments.
